name: WindFarmAvailabilityTracker
tagline: Turbine stops, contract availability, lost production and LD estimates in one plug-and-play Power Apps component.
description: A complete wind farm availability app for owners, OEM service providers and control rooms: SCADA stops with IEC 61400-26 style categories, owner / OEM agreement and disputes, repair workflow with work orders and parts, contract, operational and energy-based availability, lost production from the power curve, revenue and liquidated damages – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Contract (time-based) availability with excluded categories and maintenance allowance
Lost production from SCADA or a configurable power curve
Lost revenue and liquidated damages estimate
Owner / OEM classification: proposed, agreed, disputed, resolved
Status workflow with required fields per step
Work orders, technicians, parts ETA, root causes
Flags: long stops, overdue parts, high-wind loss, missing work orders
Bulk agree / close / assign / export, undo
Roles: operator, technician, asset manager, site manager, viewer
Demo mode with a fictional 24-turbine farm
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, keyboard and screen reader support
controlType: standard (2 controls: WindFarmAvailabilityTracker data-set + WindFarmAvailabilityTrackerPortal field)
